@ (1) a burst that a .down~(2) deals, a when~ after it inside .up~(4).down~(4): a stopped run reads the last value twice, and the runs that follow go on from the burst that was dealt

@ (2) a when~ of a value of the kind block with an at sample is the when~ with no at: read at the time of the run, not gathered (so not N samples late)
@ (2) a reset_if~ of a value of the kind block with an at sample is the reset_if~ with no at: it resets before each run of the calls with p true
@ (2) a reset_if~(p at (sample / 2)) under .up~(4).down~(4) is read at the grid of sample / 2, and is the value of a flow of its own with that reset_if~
@ (3) a reset_if~ at the second sample of a dealt burst: that sample reads the default, what was dealt before stays, and the burst after starts from the part put back
